title: Frozen Blueberry Yogurt Bites
excerpt: A creamy, crunchy and super refreshing snack. These frozen Fresh Pick blueberry bites coated in yogurt are ideal to enjoy at any time of the day.
imageAlt: Frozen Fresh Pick blueberry bites coated in Greek yogurt, arranged on parchment paper on a tray.
steps: In a medium bowl, combine the Greek yogurt with the honey, vanilla and the pinch of salt until you get a smooth, even cream.
Add the whole Fresh Pick blueberries to the yogurt mixture. Mix gently with a spatula to coat each fruit well without breaking it.
Line a freezer-safe tray or flat plate with a piece of parchment paper or a silicone sheet.
With a spoon, scoop small portions of 3 to 4 yogurt-coated blueberries and place them on the tray, spaced apart.
Freeze the tray for at least 2 hours, or until the bites are completely solid and firm to the touch.
Gently peel the bites off the parchment paper and serve right away to enjoy their creamy, crunchy texture.
tips: Because Fresh Pick blueberries are high-mountain fruit grown in Guasca and arrive with their natural bloom in perfect condition, they only need a gentle rinse before being dried well so the yogurt sticks perfectly.
Once the bites are completely frozen, transfer them to an airtight container and keep them in the freezer for up to 3 weeks.
If you want an extra crunchy touch, sprinkle a little fine granola or chopped almonds over the bites right before freezing.
